queries: WITH race_name_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS field_size FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field_size FROM race_name_stats) SELECT AVG(s.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(s.field_size) AS avg_field_size, AVG(s.field_size - o.avg_field_size) AS avg_field_size_above_overall FROM race_name_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.field_size > o.avg_field_size;
